parameters.query:
-- Look back to the last fully successful poll, plus 10 minutes for Jira's
-- search to catch up, in minutes (Jira's relative dates ignore time zones).
-- The first run starts from now. Known tickets are skipped later.
SELECT ceil(extract(epoch FROM now() - (coalesce(
         (SELECT value FROM audit.checkpoints WHERE name = 'w1'), now()) - interval '10 minutes')) / 60)::int
         AS look_back_minutes,
       now() AS polled_at;

parameters.name: jql
parameters.value: =project = "{{ $('Settings').first().json.project }}" AND status CHANGED TO "{{ $('Settings').first().json.draft_status }}" AFTER -{{ $('Get checkpoint').first().json.look_back_minutes }}m ORDER BY updated ASC

parameters.query: SELECT coalesce(json_agg(ticket || ' ' || workflow), '[]') AS known FROM audit.w1_requests;

-- Requests the gate kept back that may run now, in arrival order (Story 5.6).
SELECT coalesce(json_agg(json_build_object('queue_id', id, 'ticket', target, 'workflow', workflow,
                                           'ticket_text', payload->>'ticket_text') ORDER BY created_at, id), '[]') AS due
FROM audit.deferred_requests
WHERE action = 'dispatch' AND workflow IN ('draft-cases', 'generate-tests')
  AND done_at IS NULL AND not_before <= now();

-- One record per (ticket, workflow). A started request leaves the waiting list.
WITH saved AS (
  INSERT INTO audit.w1_requests (ticket, workflow, state, dispatched_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, CASE WHEN $3 = 'dispatched' THEN now() END)
  ON CONFLICT (ticket, workflow) DO UPDATE
    SET state = excluded.state,
        dispatched_at = coalesce(excluded.dispatched_at, audit.w1_requests.dispatched_at),
        attempts = audit.w1_requests.attempts + 1,
        updated_at = now()
  RETURNING id
), dequeued AS (
  UPDATE audit.deferred_requests SET done_at = now()
  WHERE id = $4::bigint AND $3 = 'dispatched' AND done_at IS NULL
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT (SELECT id FROM saved) AS record_id, (SELECT count(*) FROM dequeued) AS dequeued;
